proxy_hostname.description: Unique name of the Zabbix proxy, as registered in the Zabbix server.

zabbix_server_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the Zabbix server to forward collected data to.

listen_port.description: Port number on which the Zabbix proxy listens for connections from the Zabbix server.

listen_ip.description: IP address to bind to for incoming connections. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only.

db_path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite database file used by the proxy.

config_frequency.description: How often (in seconds) the proxy synchronizes its configuration with the Zabbix server.

data_frequency.description: How often (in seconds) the proxy sends collected data to the Zabbix server.

enable_remote_commands.description: Whether to allow the Zabbix server to execute remote commands on the proxy.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level: 1 = error, 2 = warning, 3 = info, 4 = debug.

log_file.description: Path to the proxy log file.

log_file_size.description: Maximum size (in MB) of the log file before rotation. Set to 0 to disable rotation.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for agent and other passive checks.

num_pollers.description: Number of worker processes for polling passive checks.

num_preprocessing_pollers.description: Number of worker processes for data preprocessing (e.g., item value transformations).

num_snmp_pollers.description: Number of worker processes for SNMP polling.

num_ipmi_pollers.description: Number of worker processes for IPMI polling.

num_http_pollers.description: Number of worker processes for HTTP agent checks.

num_db_pollers.description: Number of worker processes for database monitoring checks.

num_internal_pollers.description: Number of worker processes for internal Zabbix checks (e.g., proxy self-monitoring).

tls_connect.description: How the proxy initiates connections to the server (none, psk, cert).

tls_accept.description: Which types of incoming connections the proxy accepts (none, psk, cert).

tls_ca_file.description: Path to CA certificate file for verifying server certificates. Empty = disable.

tls_cert_file.description: Path to proxy's certificate file for certificate-based TLS.

tls_key_file.description: Path to proxy's private key file for certificate-based TLS.

unreachable_period.description: Time (in seconds) after which a host is marked unreachable if not responding.

unavailable_delay.description: Time (in seconds) between retries when a host is unavailable.

max_housekeeper_execution.description: Maximum number of tasks the housekeeper processes before pausing.

start_proxy_agents.description: Enable proxy to collect data for hosts not registered in the server (requires compatible Zabbix server).
